[DAY4 18:19:00 - DAY4 18:19:30]
I sit cross-legged and fidget with my hands. "Pretty good," I say. Shure plays guitar. Shure: "We just improvised a new song." I listen and join the conversation with Shure and Nicous. "Oh, great," I say. "Let's study it," I say. "Is this a love song?" I ask. "Is it starting?" I ask. I wave and gesture Shure to look left and then right. Shure resumes singing. Shure: "Finished singing too many others." Shure: "I just..."

[DAY4 18:17:30 - DAY4 18:17:58]
Shure plays the guitar while Katrina and Nicous look at the lyrics and the three sing; we're chatting and smiling. I tap a rhythm, play with my hands, nod along, and glance to the side.

[DAY4 17:07:33 - DAY4 17:08:00]
I watch Shure play the guitar and read the lyrics. Katrina glances at him, then returns to her phone; Nicous is on his phone too. I listen attentively—Shure sings really well.

[DAY4 17:23:01 - DAY4 17:23:29]
I listen and smile as Shure plays the guitar on one leg, wobbling. Nicous takes his phone. I laugh. Nicous wakes up; Shure hands him the guitar and walks away. We chat, then Shure returns, picks up the phone and glances at it. I say, "Oh."

[DAY4 17:22:31 - DAY4 17:22:59]
I open the door and step outside. I notice they're still singing. I see Nicous playing the guitar, then Shure takes the guitar and starts playing. Shure: "We've successfully taught Xie Bin to play the guitar." "Oh," I say. "Play a song," I add. I watch and chat with everyone as Shure plays, and I notice he doesn't hold his ground.

[DAY4 17:06:31 - DAY4 17:06:58]
I wait while Shure picks a song and starts the prelude. I listen as he strums his guitar and sways, then points to Katrina, who shyly lowers her head.

[DAY4 17:06:00 - DAY4 17:09:00]
I engaged in a casual conversation with Katrina and Nicous while observing Shure as he handled his guitar, including a moment when he removed an object stuck on it and resumed playing. Shure estimated a value of around 10 SGD, which I confirmed as equivalent to 300 points, and he addressed me formally as "Mr. Yuxuan," which I acknowledged. Preparing to perform, Shure commented on my interaction with the tablet, which I checked and clicked to assist his setup.

Shure then searched for a song on the tablet and began playing the prelude on his guitar. I observed his playing style and gestures, noting Katrina’s shy reaction. As Shure signaled us to start, we shared laughter at his humorous singing. While Nicous adjusted his hair and checked his phone, and Katrina also looked at her phone, I encouraged rehearsal and focused intermittently on my phone and Shure’s performance.

Throughout Shure’s singing and guitar playing, Nicous and Katrina alternated between engaging with their phones and responding to the music, with Katrina eventually swaying to the rhythm and Nicous sitting cross-legged while browsing. I listened attentively, occasionally adjusting my posture and interacting with my phone. When Shure indicated readiness for a new round, addressing me as "Miss Zixuan," I acknowledged the start and later confirmed the completion of the session by stating, “It’s over.”

[DAY4 17:03:00 - DAY4 17:06:00]
The group prepares for a musical performance while discussing logistics and tuning the guitar. I inquire about the purpose of an item related to bees and consider whether it should be kept dry. I then suggest ordering takeout and question if there are ingredients available to cook, pausing briefly before announcing, "It’s time to perform." Shure informs me that Yuxuan wants to sing, clarifying he did not call for Zixuan. We stand outside under an umbrella where Nicous identifies someone as Dazuo, and Shure confirms the name Zhu Zixuan, finding it amusing. I comment that the situation is a bit silly.

As Shure plays and tests the guitar, Katrina checks her phone nearby. Shure explains the tuning process, mentioning the use of an AI app to identify that the instrument was out of tune and how he adjusted it accordingly. I ask how he tuned the guitar before using the app, and Shure replies that he relied on the vibration frequency and his feeling. Nicous assists Shure with tuning on one side, and I inquire about the cost of the tuning app, to which Shure responds that it was not expensive. This sequence captures the preparation and technical discussion leading up to the performance.

[DAY4 18:10:00 - DAY4 18:20:00]
**I finished cleaning the kitchen and engaged in a conversation with Tasha.** After throwing something into the sink and confirming it was clean, I left the kitchen and entered the dining room, where Tasha was eating a roasted sweet potato and watching videos. I leaned over to see what she was watching and initiated a conversation about the term "pet funeral director," which surprised me initially. After some light-hearted chatting, I left the table.

**I moved through various rooms, observing and interacting with my surroundings.** I walked through a room with a whiteboard and entered the bathroom to wash my hands thoroughly. Afterward, I went to the computer room, where several people were working, and I searched for my glasses amidst the cluttered desk. Successfully finding them, I observed Lucia and Alice working on a pet dog model and offered suggestions.

**I engaged in casual interactions while observing others working on creative projects.** I watched Alice craft a dog and observed the lively environment filled with tools and flowers. Tasha was on her phone, and we had a brief exchange about following my lead. The atmosphere was relaxed, with everyone focused on their tasks, and I spent some time sitting and chatting with them.

**I participated in a musical session with friends in an outdoor setting.** I joined Shure, Katrina, and Nicous, who were singing and playing guitar. I nodded along to the music, enjoying the relaxed atmosphere. We were seated at an outdoor table surrounded by blue walls, and as the evening progressed, the setting was illuminated by soft lights.

**I engaged in a light-hearted conversation about music and creativity.** Sitting under an outdoor umbrella, I joined discussions about improvising songs. Shure played guitar while we chatted about love songs and creative processes, contributing to a joyful and relaxed environment. The setting was pleasant, with snacks and drinks on the table and a picturesque view of the surroundings.
